worktreeSetup: An isolated Git worktree of the implementation commit on the delivery branch, with its own cp -a copy of the existing node_modules. The full install and build still executed. Final evidence is committed without rewriting the verifier summary's recorded paths.
scope: Environment overrides apply only to this verifier process and its child commands; no persistent machine configuration was changed.
reason: The root filesystem had approximately 106 MB free before this batch and a later install attempt exhausted it (ENOSPC, exit 1, no summary). Its env/install/run logs are preserved as disk-full-attempt-* files. The final run uses an isolated /dev/shm worktree, temporary files, npm cache and pilot workspace. TMPDIR is an environment accommodation, not a PandamStyle semantic requirement.
